unit: Sample plugins (Hello World, library provider, metadata provider)
notes: Adds samples/Playnite.Sample.HelloWorld, samples/Playnite.Sample.LibraryProvider and samples/Playnite.Sample.MetadataProvider, each net11.0 with warnings as errors and one project reference to src/Playnite.SDK (Abstractions comes through the graph). Because p6-008 classified the whole Playnite.SDK.Plugins surface as deferred, the firstmate ruling added a minimal, explicitly unfrozen headless preview plugin surface in src/Playnite.SDK, new files only: IPlayniteExtension, Plugin, GenericPlugin, LibraryPlugin.GetGames, MetadataPlugin.GetMetadata/SupportedFields, GetMetadataArgs and GameMetadata in the frozen IGameView/LibraryGetGamesArgs shape, with no IPlayniteAPI, host services or UI types. Abstractions, PublicAPI text and api-baseline are unchanged; UI extension points stay deferred to p8-007 (ADR-023 addendum in docs/port/00-DECISIONS.md). tests/Playnite.Plugin.Tests adds a fake host that loads each sample assembly by reflection, discovers the SDK-owned IPlayniteExtension contract, constructs the plugin and invokes the start, library and metadata paths with concrete assertions; SamplePluginBuildTests proves net11.0, warnings-as-errors, the SDK-only reference and no product/Avalonia reference. The shared solution file Playnite.slnx is edited only to add the /samples/ folder and the Playnite.Plugin.Tests project under /tests/; it is outside the ownership map and is recorded here. Compile and load evidence only: no store, packaging, network, plugin UI or UI freeze. Local Release: plugin tests 15/15 passed zero skips, Architecture 210/210 passed zero skips.
